text: The Civic Appointments Committee will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Parking Authority Board. The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend three public members to City Council for appointment.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates to interview for appointment to the Toronto Parking Authority Board : TPA2-135 TPA2-144 TPA2-152 TPA2-159 TPA2-171 TPA2-172 TPA2-174 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1, 2, and 3 remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Parking Authority Board.
